aboutH2: Into Action Recovery 113B: Men's Recovery House in Whalley, Surrey
intro: Into Action Recovery 113B is a men's recovery house on 113B Avenue in Whalley, north Surrey. It is one of three Surrey homes where Into Action runs its First Stage residential program, a stay of 60 days or more built on groups, counselling and 12-step work.

With 52 Google reviews averaging 4.7, it is one of the more reviewed Into Action houses. Its rooms are homely, and the program leans on staff with lived experience, including a step coach, to help men who have been through treatment before and relapsed.
verifyNote: Details on this page come from the centre's own website and public listings, checked in October 2026. If you represent Into Action Recovery 113B, claim the listing to confirm or update it.

pillars.title: Lamp Light and Leather Sofas in Whalley
pillars.body: 113B is a modest house in a residential part of Whalley, close to Surrey's city centre. The living room has dark leather sofas, a wooden dresser and a wall TV, and the dining nook has a small round table under the window. Bedrooms are plain and quiet. Into Action keeps snacks out at all hours, and residents can store their own food in a labelled fridge.

pillars.title: Built for Men Who Have Relapsed Before
pillars.body: Into Action says most men do better with 60 days or more, because the first month is mostly about getting stable. At 113B the rest of the stay goes into groups on coping skills, relapse prevention and gratitude, one-to-one counselling and step work with a step coach who has more than a decade clean himself. CBT, DBT and SMART Recovery tools sit alongside the Twelve Steps.

pillars.title: Not Straight Back to the Old Routine
pillars.body: Into Action does not want men going home to the same streets and friends that fed the problem. After First Stage, men can choose Second Stage sober living for 30 days or more, with curfew, chores, daily meetings and weekly counselling, while they go back to work or school. Recovery.com lists mentoring and peer support among the aftercare for this house.

overview: 113B suits men who have tried to quit before and keep going back, and who need a longer stay in a plain, structured house to break the pattern. It handles substance use only. Detox, psychiatric care and prescriptions are arranged outside the program.

location.heading: Into Action Recovery 113B in Surrey, British Columbia
location.intro: The house is on 113B Avenue in Whalley, the older north end of Surrey near the Fraser River, about 10 minutes from Surrey Central. Downtown Vancouver is roughly 35 minutes by car over the Pattullo Bridge, New Westminster about 15 minutes, Coquitlam around 20 minutes across the Port Mann Bridge, and Langley about 25 minutes.

faqIntro: Answers come from Into Action's own website, BC's Assisted Living Registry and public listings. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: Who is Into Action Recovery 113B for?
faqs.a: Adult men with alcohol or drug addiction who need to live away from home to stop, including men who have relapsed after earlier treatment. recovery.com lists alcohol, opioids, fentanyl, cocaine, prescription drugs and repeated relapse for this house.

faqs.q: How much does Into Action Recovery 113B cost?
faqs.a: recovery.com estimates $10,000 to $30,000 CAD, depending on how long you stay. Into Action is private pay and gives exact pricing on the first phone call.

faqs.q: How long will I stay at 113B?
faqs.a: At least 60 days. That is the minimum for Into Action's First Stage, and the team can extend it. recovery.com lists a typical range of 30 to 90 days for the Surrey houses.

By giving you a long, structured stay and a plan for afterwards. Relapse prevention groups and planning run through the program, staff include a step coach for 12-step work, and men can go on to Second Stage sober living rather than straight home.

faqs.q: Is there a doctor or nurse at 113B?
faqs.a: No. Into Action is a non-medical supportive recovery program. Medical care and medication management come through a partnered virtual provider or your own doctor, and detox must be finished before you arrive.

It is at 13272 113B Avenue in the Whalley area of north Surrey. Surrey Central is about 10 minutes away, New Westminster about 15 minutes over the Pattullo Bridge, and downtown Vancouver roughly 35 minutes by car.

BC's Assisted Living Registry lists an Into Action supportive recovery residence at 13294 113B Avenue, registration SU2025-00013, under Fraser Health. Its street number differs from the 13272 address Into Action and Google give, so ask admissions to confirm which building you will stay in.

faqs.q: Can I go out during my stay?
faqs.a: Yes, with the house at first and on your own later. Staff take residents to meetings, shopping, walks and hikes. After the restriction period you can ask for personal outings and weekend passes.

faqs.q: What are the house rules at 113B?
faqs.a: Group attendance is mandatory, smoking is allowed only in a designated area, and family contact begins after the restriction period. Residents can bring their own snacks and protein powder.
